title: Wedding & Event Day Excellence
blurb: How to prepare for, run and quietly rescue a wedding or event day so the couple see a seamless day.
siteNotes: Where the running order and special requests are kept for each event
Who leads the event team on the day
legalNotes: No legal rules in this trainer; it is service good practice.

cards.kicker: Events and front of house · 10 minutes
cards.title: Wedding & Event Day Excellence
cards.body:
By the end of this session you can:
- prepare by knowing the plan and special requests
- stay one step ahead and communicate calmly
- fix problems discreetly

cards.title: It is their day
cards.body: For a couple, their wedding is one of the most important days of their lives, and they have chosen us to make it perfect. That is a real privilege and a real responsibility. Our job is to make it feel effortless, even when we are working flat out behind the scenes.

items.title: Their day
items.text: One of the most important of their lives.

items.title: Memories
items.text: We are part of the photographs.

cards.title: Preparation is everything
cards.body: Before the day starts, know the running order, the timings and any special requests inside out. Present the room immaculately, and present yourself the same way.

cards.title: Stay one step ahead
cards.body: Anticipate what is coming next so you are ready before you are needed. Communicate calmly and clearly with the kitchen and the rest of the team, and keep the couple and their key people informed without fuss.

items.title: Communicate
items.text: Calm and clear, with the kitchen and team.

items.title: Keep informed
items.text: Couple and key people, no fuss.

cards.title: Fix it quietly
cards.body: Occasionally something will go wrong. Solve it discreetly. The couple and their guests should never see the stress; they should see a beautiful, seamless day.

right.title: Do not
items: Let the couple see the stress

cards.title: Remember
cards.body:
- Know the running order, timings and special requests before the day
- Present the room and yourself immaculately
- Anticipate what is coming next
- Communicate calmly and clearly with the kitchen and team
- Fix problems discreetly so the day looks seamless

cards.q: For the couple, their wedding is one of the most important days of their lives.
cards.why: It is a real privilege and a real responsibility.

cards.q: Which two things should you know before the day starts?
options: The photographer's fee and the menu cost
The guest list and the table prices
The running order and any special requests
The bar takings and the staff rota
cards.why: Know the running order, timings and special requests, such as dietary needs, inside out.

cards.q: When something goes wrong, you should solve it…
options: As soon as a manager appears
cards.why: The couple and their guests should never see the stress.

cards.q: You should stay one step ahead and anticipate what is coming next.
cards.why: Be ready before you are needed.

cards.q: The room and your presentation should be…
options: Matched to how busy the day is
cards.why: You are part of the picture in their memories and photographs.

cards.q: The couple should see a seamless day, not the stress behind it.
cards.why: Fix problems quietly and keep smiling.

cards.q: What makes a complex event day look easy?
options: Keeping the couple out of the room
Keeping to a very short timetable
cards.why: Smooth teamwork is what makes a complex day look easy.

cards.q: Special requests can be ignored if the day gets busy.
cards.why: Special requests matter, such as dietary needs or a step-free route.

cards.q: Communication with the kitchen and team should be…
cards.why: Communicate calmly and clearly with the kitchen and the rest of the team.

cards.q: We are helping create memories the couple will keep for a lifetime.
cards.why: Get it right and you will have helped create memories a couple keeps for a lifetime.
